style.backgroundSystem: only four background planes across the whole set: a seamless pale lilac chalk studio field #EFEAF3, a dusty lilac panel #C9BEDB, a mid violet resin field #8E7BA8 and a full deep plum field #4A3B6B, one dominant plane per screen with at most one hard horizontal edge where a wall plane meets a table plane; the set is never lit by a warm ivory glow and never by a clinical cold wash; no gradient mesh, no sky, no marble, no water ripple or splash field, no bubble badge, no leaf or botanical shadow cut-out, no weathered plaster, no blurred interior scenery, no warm wood, no aqua-teal-cyan-mint wash, no smoke-grey-satin-silver-graphite-blush-coral wash
style.iconSystem: small arch-topped tablet frames (a rectangle with a semicircular top, like a vitrine window) drawn with one 1.2pt mulberry rose #A85577 line on light planes and one 1.2pt pale lilac #EFEAF3 line on the deep plum plane, laid in a stepped cascade that descends from left to right with an even vertical offset between neighbours, never in a single flat horizontal row and never in a vertical left rail; every tablet stays icon-only and blank with no lettering inside it; step numerals are knocked out in pale lilac #EFEAF3 from a solid mulberry rose #A85577 disc; no rounded-square line chip of radius 12, no bare hairline pictogram drawn straight onto the plane, no knockout square with a 2px corner radius, no outlined circle, dotted ring or capsule; no bacteria, virus, microbe, cell or pathogen artwork, no cartoon germ mascot, no electron-microscope sphere, no flask, beaker, test-tube, hourglass, microscope, shield or red-cross shape
style.lightingSystem: the light comes from inside the set, not from a lamp position: one large diffused backlight panel placed behind and below the product so it shines through the frosted opal light-table #F3EFF8 and through the translucent bottle body and every gel bead, at 5000K, plus one narrow low-power soft frontal fill from camera-left whose only job is to keep the black closure readable and to hold a thin edge separation line on the bottle shoulder; the resulting shadow is always one soft pool sitting forward toward the camera under the base, never a long directional corner shadow; no upper-left or upper-right single key, no high-front near-symmetric key, no strong side rake, never flat shadowless beauty light, never rim-only low-key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent violet-vitrine backlit hand-gel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a seamless pale lilac chalk studio field #EFEAF3, deep aubergine ink copy #2A2540, a dusty lilac panel #C9BEDB, a mid violet resin field #8E7BA8, a full deep plum field #4A3B6B and one mulberry rose accent #A85577; neutral temperature at 5000K carried entirely by transmitted light, never a warm cast and never a clinical cool cast; lighting system of one large diffused backlight panel behind and below the product shining through a frosted opal light-table #F3EFF8 so the translucent bottle body and every gel bead glow from within, plus one narrow low-power soft frontal fill from camera-left that only keeps the black closure readable and holds a thin edge separation on the shoulder, one soft pool shadow sitting forward toward camera under the base, never an upper-left, upper-right or high-front key and never a corner-falling directional shadow; one extended wide-tracked light-weight sans-serif only, copy set inside arch-topped vitrine frames instead of a top-centred title block, deep aubergine #2A2540 lettering on chalk #EFEAF3, dusty lilac #C9BEDB and mid violet #8E7BA8 and pale lilac #EFEAF3 lettering on deep plum #4A3B6B, mulberry #A85577 reserved for numerals and one thin rule, headline 30-42pt, sub-line 15-18pt, wide-tracked caps at 10-12pt, Chinese copy always inside 「」, no calligraphy, no serif, no handwriting, no condensed grotesque; backgrounds limited to the chalk field #EFEAF3, the dusty lilac panel #C9BEDB, the mid violet field #8E7BA8 and the deep plum field #4A3B6B, one dominant plane per screen, at most one hard horizontal edge, no gradient, no marble, no water ripple or splash, no bubble badge, no leaf shadow, no aqua-teal-mint wash, no warm ivory-oatmeal-moss-brass staging, no grey-silver-graphite-coral staging; surfaces limited to a frosted opal light-table top #F3EFF8, a polished pale-amethyst glass brick #C9BEDB, a mid violet matte resin panel #8E7BA8 and a deep plum flocked cube #4A3B6B, no stone counter, no porcelain tile, no brass edge, no sand mat, no aluminium riser, no graphite slab, no micro-cement, no smoked acrylic, no wood, rattan or linen; icon system of arch-topped tablet frames drawn in one 1.2pt mulberry #A85577 line on light planes and one 1.2pt pale lilac #EFEAF3 line on plum, laid in a stepped cascade descending left to right, every tablet icon-only and blank, step numerals knocked out in pale lilac #EFEAF3 from a solid mulberry #A85577 disc, never a rounded-square chip, never a bare hairline pictogram row, never a knockout square, no germ, microbe, flask, hourglass, microscope or shield shape; the bottle always standing on its own flat base with the black disc-top closure seated, closed and screwed down and its integrated push-up nozzle readable on the flat top face, round shoulders and high fill level unchanged, the front label a blank legible field in its reference position and never re-lettered or redesigned, the gel always a coherent viscous mass with true surface tension that holds a domed edge and never a watery run, never touching skin and only dispensed onto inert glass or resin, the closure never turned into a trigger sprayer, mist atomiser, lotion pump skirt or oval flip-lid, product scale constant, every unit grounded by its own soft forward pool shadow; generous cool lilac negative space; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no germ-kill rate, percentage, log value, pathogen name or microbe illustration, no alcohol concentration figure, no medical, skin or wound indication and no red-cross emblem, no hygiene-registration or filing code, no certificate artwork, no food-contact or edible staging, no open flame or flammable warning, no hand, child or infant in frame, no running or watery gel, no QR code or membership sticker.
noDrift: no mixed fonts, no calligraphy, no serif, no condensed grotesque

no lamp-style key light: the set is lit by transmitted backlight through the table and body plus a low-power frontal fill, never an upper-left, upper-right or high-front single key and never a corner-falling shadow
no aqua-teal-cyan-mint clinical wash, no warm ivory-oatmeal-moss-brass staging, no smoke-grey-satin-silver-graphite-blush-coral staging, none of those three neighbouring palettes may be mixed in
no arch tablets drawn as rounded squares, bare hairline pictograms or knockout squares, and no lettering inside any icon
no redrawn, re-lettered, resized or restyled label copy: the front label stays a blank legible field in its reference position
no alcohol concentration figure of any kind, no percentage, kill rate, inactivation claim, log value, colony plate, pathogen or germ name and no microbe, virus or cell illustration
no medical, therapeutic, dermatological, skin-suitability, hypoallergenic, wound-care or surgical indication, no red-cross or medical-shield emblem and no clinical-gown or examination-room staging
no hygiene-registration filing number, 卫消字 or 卫生许可证 code, approval number, factory standard, test report or certificate artwork
no food-contact, food-grade, edible, ingestion or hand-after-eating staging and no produce, dishware, cutlery, cup or takeout container in frame
no open flame, spark, lit stove, candle, burner, cigarette, lighter or flammable-warning iconography and no keep-from-fire or flammable wording
no gel, drop or bottle touching skin, face, lips, eyes, an abrasion, an injection site or a bandage, and no hand, finger or palm anywhere in the set
no infant, child, pregnant person, toy, pacifier or baby bottle in frame and no keep-out-of-reach-of-children wording
no watery run, spreading puddle, feathered stain, dripping stream, mist, splash, ripple field or foam: the gel always keeps a coherent domed edge
no QR code, membership sticker, free-gift patch, price burst or red promotional patch
style.presentationRules: the bottle always stands on its own flat base, or lies face-up on that same base plane in the overhead carry screen, with the black disc-top closure seated, closed and threaded down and its integrated push-up dispensing nozzle readable on the flat top face, the round-shoulded clear body and the high fill level unchanged, the front label kept a blank legible field in its reference position and never re-lettered, re-scaled or repainted; the gel is always a coherent viscous mass with true surface tension: a clean-domed bead or a slow-moving rope that keeps its own edge, never a watery run, never a flat spreading puddle, never a thin feathered stain, never a coloured dye and never a foam; the closure is never re-sculpted into a trigger sprayer, a fine-mist atomiser, a wide lotion-pump skirt, an oval flip-lid or a screw ring left off the bottle; gel never touches skin, face, a wound or a bandage and is only ever dispensed onto an inert glass or resin surface; product scale constant across the set and every unit grounded by its own soft forward pool shadow; no percentage, germ name, kill-rate badge, medical cross, shield rosette or claim band is ever painted back onto the label
style.surfaceSystem: frosted opal light-table top #F3EFF8, polished pale-amethyst glass brick #C9BEDB, mid violet matte resin panel #8E7BA8, deep plum flocked cube #4A3B6B, always with a visible soft forward pool shadow where the base meets the table; no pale-grey stone counter, no frosted glass riser, no brushed stainless shelf edge, no clear glass tray, no porcelain-ivory tile, no ribbed cream plaster block, no brushed brass edge, no pale-sand low-pile mat, no brushed aluminium riser, no graphite plaster slab, no micro-cement counter, no smoked acrylic sheet, no timber board, no rattan, no straw, no linen
style.typography: one extended wide-tracked light-weight sans-serif only, copy set inside arch-topped vitrine frames rather than in a top-centred title block; deep aubergine ink #2A2540 lettering on the chalk field #EFEAF3, the dusty lilac panel #C9BEDB and the mid violet field #8E7BA8, pale lilac #EFEAF3 lettering on the deep plum field #4A3B6B, mulberry rose #A85577 reserved for numerals and for one thin rule; headline placeholders 30-42pt at light weight, sub-line 15-18pt, labels in wide-tracked caps at 10-12pt; short Chinese copy always inside 「」; no calligraphy, no serif display, no handwriting, no condensed grotesque, no rounded geometric sans, no pinyin or english eyebrow lines
